name: Tiger eye (SLC24A5)
summary: A bright amber iris in a horse whose coat is entirely ordinary. It is the first gene in the mod that changes only the eyes, and the reason the eye-colour channel exists at all. Essentially confined to the Puerto Rican Paso Fino, in life and here.

phenotypes.name: Tiger eye carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy, which shows nothing at all - not in the eyes and not in the coat. Two carriers bred together is the only way amber eyes appear.

phenotypes.name: Tiger eye (amber)
phenotypes.description: A bright amber iris, the colour of a hawk's eye, in a horse whose coat is entirely ordinary. Nothing else about the horse changes.

phenotypes.name: Tiger eye (yellow)
phenotypes.description: The paler, more yellow shade two TE2 copies produce - the same trait a stop lighter than the amber TE1 gives.
